bundle.longDescription: PrimeBuild Official Store is the Product Builder for PrimeBuild's commercial channel: the environment from which PrimeBuild Store (website, future app, catalog, checkout and every public channel) is designed, configured, administered, analysed, published and evolved. It is not the store, not the storefront and not what a customer uses — PrimeBuild Store is the product it builds, not a separate project. Built for the operator, never the customer; its current capability is read-only, which is declared architectural debt. Independent app that belongs only to PrimeBuild — not CoinOS, PrimeBuild Internal OS, Eventra or Partnera. This desktop build runs the local server in a dedicated window and can rebuild itself automatically via the auto-rebuild pipeline.
